profile.headline: Cloud Software Engineer I at The College Board
profile.summary: I am a Cloud Software Engineer at The College Board. Currently learning more about python and AWS cloud services.

positions.title: Astronomical Observer & Undergraduate Researcher for Professor Ryan Foley
positions.description:
•	Worked on Gravitational Wave (GW) localization code in Python
•	Developed strategies to streamline a list of galaxies and feed it into a code that contributed to the discovery of the optical counterpart, SSS17a
•	Got experience running the Nickel telescope GUI interface
•	Collected photometric data of targets on observation nights

positions.title: Service Coordinator Assistant
positions.description:
•	Provided customer service online, on the phone, and in person
•	Organized calendar, restocked office supplies, and cleaned work area
•	Aided customers with submitting phone and Ethernet work orders

company.name: UC Santa Cruz Information Technologies Services (ITS) Department

positions.title: Math & Physics Tutor
positions.description:
•	Tutored all math and physics levels offered including calculus, differential equations, and the introductory physics series
•	Clearly and effectively guided students through class material in a manner that was unique to their learning style
•	Awarded Employee (Tutor) of the month in May 2015

honors.title: Conference for Undergraduate Women in Physics (CUWIP)
honors.description: I was invited to attend this conference at UCLA in 2017 and at The Claremont Colleges in 2018.

honors.title: Koret Foundation Scholar
honors.description: I was awarded $1,500 to fund academic research in Gravitational Wave localization and I presented a poster on "The Search for Gravitational Wave Sources" at Koret Research Slam.
